# Chilled Water Plant Sequence of Operations (Module CHW)

Draft for the BAS specification. Every value marked "confirm" in the setpoint list is my proposal, not a given. Each requirement uses present tense and is mandatory for the BAS. Chiller protective trips stay in the chiller panels and are not restated here.

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| Function | Make and distribute chilled water to the building air handlers, including the surgery suites. Keep N+1 chiller capacity. |
| Upstream | Utility and generator power. Cooling tower makeup and water treatment are out of scope. |
| Downstream | AHU coil valves and the critical air handler (DPT-710). AHU control is in the AHU modules. |
| Interfaces | Chiller panels (local control, protection), VFDs, AHU controllers (valve positions, reset-disable). |
| SIS | None identified. Any safety function belongs in the SRS. See open item OI-12. |

**Assumptions (confirm in the open items):**
- CH-1/2/3 are identical. Two are duty chillers and one is standby.
- CHWP-n is the default pump for CH-n. The pumps are headered, so any available pump serves any chiller.
- CWP-n and CT-n are dedicated to CH-n by default.
- FIT-702 measures total primary flow through the running chillers.

## 2. Equipment, tags, and setpoints

| TT-721 | CHW return header |

| XV-131/132/133 | CT-n cell isolation valves |

## 3. General rules, states, and transitions

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-001 | A unit is "available" when it is in AUTO, has no fault, has no latched interlock, has good comms, and is not locked out for maintenance. | Sim each condition |
| FR-CHW-002 | N+1 is OK when the available chiller count exceeds SP-17. The BAS shows N+1 status and raises AL-CHW-03 when it is not OK. | Sim chiller faults |
| FR-CHW-003 | The BAS does not stop the last running chiller, except for operator DISABLE or ABORTING. | Sim low load |
| FR-CHW-004 | Plant tons = FIT-702 × (TT-721 − TT-720) ÷ SP-49. Load % = plant tons ÷ (running chillers × SP-01). | Inject flow and temperatures |
| FR-CHW-005 | The BAS keeps a lead/lag/standby list by run hours. The operator can override it. | Change run hours |
| FR-CHW-006 | Running CHWP count equals running chiller count. A failed pump is replaced by an available pump. | Fail a pump |

**ISA-106 state table.** Plant mode is AUTO or MANUAL. In MANUAL the operator runs equipment and the BAS does not stage.

| State | Entry condition | Exits (initiator) | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|
| STOPPED | Initial; STOPPING complete; ABORTED reset | → STARTING on ENABLE with start permissives true (operator) | Operator-initiated |
| STARTING | ENABLE | → RUNNING when the first chiller runs (auto). → HOLDING on HOLD (operator). → ABORTING when no equipment is available or E-stop (auto). → STOPPING on DISABLE (operator). | Automatic |
| RUNNING | First chiller proven running; RESTARTING complete | → HOLDING on HOLD (operator). → STOPPING on DISABLE (operator). → ABORTING on E-stop or loss of all pumps or all chillers (auto). | Automatic |
| HOLDING | HOLD command | → HELD when stage actions in progress are complete (auto). Running equipment continues. | Automatic |
| HELD | HOLDING complete | → RESTARTING on RESUME (operator-prompted). → STOPPING on DISABLE. → ABORTING as in RUNNING. | Operator-prompted |
| RESTARTING | RESUME, or BAS power-up with retained state | → RUNNING when the sequence in 5.7 completes (auto). → ABORTING on failure (auto). | Automatic |
| STOPPING | DISABLE | → STOPPED when all chillers and pumps are stopped (auto) | Automatic |
| ABORTING | Abort cause | → ABORTED when chillers are stopped and post-run is complete (auto) | Automatic |
| ABORTED | ABORTING complete | → STOPPED on RESET after the cause clears (operator) | Manual |

In HELD, staging, reset, and rotation are frozen. Protective actions (5.4) stay active.

## 4. Regulatory control

No tuning values are given here.

| ID | Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior and override | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-101 | Distribution DP | DPT-710, target SP-06 | Common speed to running CHWPs | PV below target raises speed | AUTO or MAN. Clamp between SP-07 and SP-08. High-select with the low-flow override (FR-CHW-306). | Vary DP |
| FR-CHW-102 | Minimum flow bypass | FIT-702, target = running chillers × SP-02 × (1 + SP-04) | FCV-701 | PV below target opens | AUTO or MAN. Fully open on pump start. Fails open. | Throttle flow |
| FR-CHW-103 | CHWST | TT-720, target = active setpoint | Setpoint sent to running chillers | Chiller panels modulate capacity | Base is SP-11, limit is SP-12 | Change setpoint |
| FR-CHW-104 | CWST | TT-730, target = AT-750 + SP-37, limited SP-38 to SP-39 | Common speed to enabled CT fans | PV above target raises speed | Fans not below SP-40 while enabled. AUTO or MAN. | Vary wet-bulb |
| FR-CHW-105 | Tower cells | CT fan speed | CT cell enable | Enabled cells = running chillers | Add a cell when fans exceed SP-41 for SP-42. Remove one when fans stay below SP-43 for SP-44. | Sim speeds |

**CHWST reset (FR-CHW-110).** Every SP-13, the BAS reads the most-open coil valve among the reset-group AHUs. It skips valves with bad signals.
- Above SP-15: lower the setpoint by SP-14, not below SP-11.
- Below SP-16: raise it by SP-14, not above SP-12.
- Otherwise: hold.

The reset holds during staging and in HELD. It returns to SP-11 at the same step rate when any surgery AHU sends a reset-disable. It also returns there when the plant is not RUNNING. Test: sim valve positions and reset-disable.

## 5. Sequences

Chiller n means the selected CH, with its pump, CWP, and tower cell. Steps use the pump and valve tags from section 2.

### 5.1 Plant start (ENABLE)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-210 | Check permissives: one available chiller, CHWP, CWP, and CT cell; no latched abort; DPT-710 and FIT-702 valid. | All true | SP-29 | Stay STOPPED. Raise AL-CHW-01 with the reason. |
| FR-CHW-211 | Select lead chiller, pump, CWP, and CT cell from the list. | Selection made | SP-29 | Select the next available. If none, ABORTING. |
| FR-CHW-212 | Open FCV-701, XV-11n, XV-12n, and XV-13n. | End switches proved open | SP-30 | Alarm AL-CHW-18. Mark the chiller unavailable and return to 211. If only FCV-701 fails, continue. |
| FR-CHW-213 | Start the CHWP at SP-07 speed. | Pump proven | SP-29 | Lock out the pump. Repeat with another pump. If none, ABORTING. |
| FR-CHW-214 | Release the DP and bypass loops to AUTO. | FIT-702 at or above the minimum-flow target | SP-31 | Raise pump speed to SP-08. If still low, stop the pump, alarm, and repeat 213 with another pump. |
| FR-CHW-215 | Start the CWP and enable the CT cell. Release the fan loop to AUTO. | CW flow proven | SP-29 | Alarm. Mark the chiller unavailable and return to 211. |
| FR-CHW-216 | Command the chiller to run at the active CHWST setpoint. | Chiller reports running | SP-32 | Alarm AL-CHW-07. Mark unavailable and return to 211. If none, ABORTING. |
| FR-CHW-217 | Enter RUNNING. | | | |

Test: FAT with simulated equipment. Start, then fail each step in turn.

### 5.2 Stage up

**Triggers.** Any one of the following, true for SP-20:
- Load % above SP-18.
- TT-720 above the active setpoint plus SP-19.
- FIT-702 divided by running chillers above SP-05.
- Pump speed at SP-08 and DPT-710 below SP-06.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-220 | Confirm the trigger delay, that lockout SP-23 has expired, and that a chiller is available. | All true | SP-20 | If no chiller is available, AL-CHW-05. Stay at the current stage. |
| FR-CHW-221 | Select the next chiller in lag order. | Selected | SP-29 | Select the next. If none, AL-CHW-05. |
| FR-CHW-222 | Raise the minimum-flow target. Open XV-11n, XV-12n, XV-13n. | End switches open | SP-30 | Mark unavailable, restore the target, return to 221. |
| FR-CHW-223 | Start a spare CHWP at the speed of the running pumps. Start the CWP. | Both proven | SP-29 | Lock out the failed unit and select another. If none, inhibit and AL-CHW-05. |
| FR-CHW-224 | Command the chiller to run. | Reports running | SP-32 | Alarm. Mark unavailable, stop its pumps after SP-34, restore the target, return to 221. |
| FR-CHW-225 | Start lockout SP-23. | | | |

### 5.3 Stage down

**Conditions.** All of the following, true for SP-22:
- Plant tons divided by (running chillers − 1) × SP-01 is below SP-21.
- FIT-702 divided by (running chillers − 1) is below SP-05.
- No stage-up trigger is true.
- The stage-down candidate has run for SP-24.
- Lockout SP-23 has expired.
- No running chiller has a comm loss.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-230 | Confirm the conditions above. | True | SP-22 | Stay at the current stage. |
| FR-CHW-231 | Select the most recently started chiller. | Selected | SP-29 | Cancel the stage-down. |
| FR-CHW-232 | Command the chiller to stop. | Reports stopped | SP-33 | Cancel the stage-down. Keep all running. AL-CHW-07. |
| FR-CHW-233 | Run its pump and CWP for SP-34. Lower the minimum-flow target. | Post-run complete | SP-34 | None needed. The timer is the step. |
| FR-CHW-234 | Close XV-11n and XV-12n. Stop the spare CHWP and CWP. Remove the CT cell. | Valves closed, pumps stopped | SP-30 | Alarm AL-CHW-18. Stop the pumps anyway. |
| FR-CHW-235 | Start lockout SP-23. | | | |

### 5.4 Running chiller failure and standby start

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-240 | Detect a running chiller that is unavailable (trip, CWP loss, comm loss with temperature rise). | Condition true | SP-51 | None. Detection step. |
| FR-CHW-241 | Start the next available chiller by steps 221–224. Skip SP-20 and SP-23. | Reports running | SP-32 | Try the next. If none, 243. |
| FR-CHW-242 | Run the failed chiller's pumps for SP-34. Then close its valves. Latch it unavailable. | Valves closed | SP-30 | AL-CHW-18. Leave the valves as they are. |
| FR-CHW-243 | If no chiller is available, show DEGRADED and raise AL-CHW-03. Keep remaining equipment running. | | | Operator prompt P-04 |

Test: trip each running chiller in the FAT model. Confirm the standby starts and N+1 alarms.

### 5.5 Lead rotation

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-250 | Start rotation at SP-25, on operator command, or when the lead chiller fails. Require N+1 OK. | True | SP-29 | Defer to the next interval. |
| FR-CHW-251 | Start the next lead chiller by steps 221–224. | Reports running | SP-32 | Cancel rotation. Keep the old lead running. |
| FR-CHW-252 | After SP-24 of loaded run, stop the old lead by steps 231–235. | Stopped | SP-33 | Cancel. Alarm. |
| FR-CHW-253 | Update the lead list. | | | |

### 5.6 Plant stop (DISABLE)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-260 | Show prompt P-02. | Operator confirms | SP-52 | Cancel the stop. |
| FR-CHW-261 | Freeze staging and reset. Command all chillers to stop. | All stopped | SP-33 | Keep pumps and CWPs running. AL-CHW-07. Prompt P-05. |
| FR-CHW-262 | Run pumps and towers for SP-34. | Timer done | SP-34 | None. |
| FR-CHW-263 | Stop CWPs, CT fans, and CHWPs. Close XV valves. Open FCV-701. | Proven stopped | SP-30 | AL-CHW-18. |
| FR-CHW-264 | Enter STOPPED. | | | |

### 5.7 Power loss and restart

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-270 | On BAS power-up, read the retained state. If RUNNING, STARTING, or RESTARTING, enter RESTARTING. | State valid | SP-29 | State invalid: AL-CHW-02 and prompt P-06. Do not start automatically. |
| FR-CHW-271 | Wait for stable power. | No power event for SP-45 | SP-36 | Keep waiting. AL-CHW-20. |
| FR-CHW-272 | Open FCV-701 and the lead valves. Start pumps one at a time, SP-46 apart. | Proven | SP-29 each | As 213. |
| FR-CHW-273 | Start CWP and the CT cell. | Proven | SP-29 | As 215. |
| FR-CHW-274 | Start the lead chiller as in 216. Use SP-47 as the stage-up delay for SP-48. | Reports running | SP-32 | As 216. |
| FR-CHW-275 | Return to the normal stage-up delay. Enter RUNNING. | | | |

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was given, so the rows are written here.

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-300 | Running CHWP loses proof | Start spare pump at the same speed. Lock out the failed pump. | Latched | Operator, after fault clears | Fail pump |
| FR-CHW-301 | CHWP loss with no spare, and running chillers exceed available pumps | Stop the most recently started chiller by 231–235 without delay | Latched with the pump | Operator | Fail two pumps |
| FR-CHW-302 | CWP-n loses proof while CH-n runs | Remove CH-n run command. Mark unavailable. Run 5.4. | Latched | Operator | Fail CWP |
| FR-CHW-303 | XV-11n or XV-12n not open | Inhibit chiller start | Auto-reset | Valve proved open | Block valve |
| FR-CHW-304 | Chiller reports fault or trip | Mark unavailable. Run 5.4. | Latched | Operator, after chiller panel reset | Sim trip |
| FR-CHW-305 | CT fan fault | Mark cell unavailable. Enable spare cell. | Latched | Operator | Fault fan |
| FR-CHW-306 | FIT-702 below minimum with FCV-701 fully open for SP-35 | Raise pump speed up to SP-08. AL-CHW-13. | Auto-reset | Flow at or above the minimum | Throttle flow |
| FR-CHW-307 | TT-720 above SP-28 for SP-27 | Start standby by 241. AL-CHW-12. | Auto-reset | TT-720 below the active setpoint plus SP-26 | Sim temperature |
| FR-CHW-308 | Hardwired E-stop status | ABORTING | Latched | Operator, after the physical reset | Sim input |
| FR-CHW-309 | TT-730 below SP-38 | Hold tower fans at SP-40 | Auto-reset | TT-730 recovers | Sim temperature |

The hardwired E-stop is in the electrical design. The BAS only reads its status.

No alarm database was given. Priorities are proposals for the ISA-18.2 rationalization.

| AL-CHW-04 | Standby chiller in use | Running chillers exceed SP-17 | Low | Watch load. |
| AL-CHW-05 | No chiller for stage-up | 220–224 find none | High | Restore a chiller. |
| AL-CHW-07 | Chiller unavailable or failed to start or stop | 216, 224, 232, 240, 261 | High | Check the chiller panel. |
| AL-CHW-08 | CHWP fault | FR-CHW-300 | Medium | Repair the pump. |
| AL-CHW-09 | CWP fault | FR-CHW-302 | Medium | Repair the pump. |
| AL-CHW-10 | CT fault | FR-CHW-305 | Low | Repair the fan. |
| AL-CHW-11 | CHWST high | TT-720 above active setpoint plus SP-26 for SP-27 | Medium | Check chillers. |
| AL-CHW-12 | CHWST critical | FR-CHW-307 | High | Confirm the standby has started. |
| AL-CHW-13 | Low primary flow | FR-CHW-306 | High | Check pumps and valves. |
| AL-CHW-14 | Capacity limit reached | All available chillers run, pumps at SP-08, DPT-710 below SP-06 for SP-20 | High | Tell the surgery manager. |
| AL-CHW-15 | Sensor bad | DPT-710, DPT-711, FIT-702, TT-720, TT-721, TT-730 | Medium | Repair the sensor. |

| AL-CHW-17 | VFD comm loss | No data for SP-50 | Medium | Check the network. |

## 8. Abnormal handling

| ID | Condition | Plant response | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-500 | DPT-710 bad | Use DPT-711 if it is valid. Otherwise run pumps at SP-09. AL-CHW-15. | Disconnect signal |
| FR-CHW-501 | FIT-702 bad | Hold FCV-701 at SP-10. Stage on average chiller load % from the chiller panels. | Disconnect signal |
| FR-CHW-502 | TT-720 or TT-721 bad | Use chiller leaving-water temperature. Hold CHWST at SP-11. Stage on chiller load %. | Disconnect signal |
| FR-CHW-503 | TT-730 or AT-750 bad | Hold CWST target at SP-39 and keep fans on AUTO. | Disconnect signal |
| FR-CHW-504 | AHU valve signal bad or AHU comm loss | Skip that AHU in the reset. If all are bad, hold SP-11. | Disconnect AHU |
| FR-CHW-505 | Chiller comm loss | Treat a running chiller as running. Block stage-down. Mark a stopped chiller unavailable. | Disconnect chiller |
| FR-CHW-506 | VFD comm loss | VFD goes to the preset speed SP-09. Run and fault status are hardwired. | SAT: pull comms |
| FR-CHW-507 | BAS controller failure | Chillers run on local control. VFDs hold the preset speed. FCV-701 fails open. XV valves fail as last position. | SAT: power off |
| FR-CHW-508 | Power loss | All non-generator equipment stops. On return, run 5.7. | Sim power loss |
| FR-CHW-509 | N+1 lost | AL-CHW-03. Keep operating. Show prompt P-04. | Disable one chiller |

**Fail positions:**
- FCV-701: open.
- XV-11n, XV-12n, XV-13n: last position.
- Pump VFDs: preset speed SP-09.

All of these are confirmed in OI-07 and OI-11.
